notes: Tail case re-examined on the clean source. U1/U2 masks were whole women; re-segmented to their T-shirts (SAM3, v2). U2 replace now T-shirt -> hooded sweatshirt. U4 is the blue railing panel between the two white posts at the top of the steps (near center), not the right-hand railing; mask kept, payload made specific.
